note: Black Hills NF campground in ponderosa pine beside small Roubaix Lake, about 13 mi S of Deadwood off US-385 (FR-255), run by a concessionaire in summer. Four loops; the sites at the meadow edge east of Loop D (50-53 on the FS map) look across the meadow to the lake. Swim beach, fishing and non-motorized boating at the adjoining day-use area, free to campers; a 1-mile multi-use trail open to off-road vehicles links to the forest trail network. Generators 6 a.m.-10 p.m. --Claude

Lakeview KEPT (meadow-edge sites ~130 m across open meadow). Season year-round w/ note, booking (some_sites, booking.season), fees, sites, facilities written; note cleaned. flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT (weakly). Roubaix Lake is small (~3 ha on imagery). The nearest RV sites are the meadow-edge sites east of Loop D (50-53 on the FS map, first-come, not in the rec.gov catalog; an RV visible at ~44.1975,-103.6638 on Esri), ~130 m from the lake's reed fringe across an open meadow with scattered trees and clumps; Loop D's catalogued sites (048 44.19741,-103.66355; 054/055) sit in pines ~190 m back. Loop C's tent sites 026-029 are ~80 m from the lake's north (dam) end across the access road and parking. No RV site within ~50 m. rec.gov/FS say 'many offer lake views' (prose only). If the reviewer wants a firmer view than imagery of an open meadow, it would go to not waterfront.

Suggested waterfront_evidence: 'Esri imagery 2026-11-21 with rec.gov site coordinates: meadow-edge RV sites E of Loop D (~44.1975,-103.6638; 50-53 on FS map) look ~130 m across open meadow with scattered trees to Roubaix Lake (~3 ha); no RV site within 50 m; tent sites 026-029 ~80 m from the dam end behind road/parking -> lakeview.'
FEES: rec.gov $30 peak vs FS page '$28 / night' - wrote rec.gov per the standing rule. Off-season $15 (FS page and rec.gov notice agree).
FIT: rec.gov sites 015 and 018 are 20 ft; off-season Loop C 'Parking Spur Length is 2 5 ft' (25 ft) - a 23-ft rig fits; 23 of the 25 catalogued RV sites take 34-46 ft.
OHV: the recreation description says off-road vehicle riders use a 1-mile multi-use trail to a trail network - a general campground with trail access (stays), not a staging area.

PHONE: empty -> (661) 702-1420 (rec.gov 'For facility specific information, please call'; concessionaire ExplorUS); off-season the Northern Hills Ranger District (605) 642-4622 (FS page). rec.gov facility_phone 605-673-9200 is the forest supervisor's office.
DISCOUNTS: the concession honours Senior/Access passes ('only honored for the site that houses the card holder') - matches the federal row.
STATUS: 'Site Partially Closed - Loop C is open, all other loops are closed' is the ordinary seasonal closing, not a status.
